Test Case: Navigate to /signup and submit the form with valid name / email / password
Expected Result: Account is created and user is directed to the verify-pending page

Test Case: Submit the signup form with an email that is already registered
Expected Result: An error message is shown, no duplicate account is created

Test Case: Submit the signup form with an invalid email format
Expected Result: Validation error is shown and the form does not submit

Test Case: Submit the signup form with a password that does not meet requirements
Expected Result: Validation error explains password requirements

Test Case: Submit the signup form with empty required fields
Expected Result: Each empty required field shows a validation error

Test Case: After signup check inbox for verification email
Expected Result: Verification email arrives with a working verification link

Test Case: Click the verification link in the email
Expected Result: User lands on verify-email page and account is marked verified

Test Case: Attempt to use an expired or already-used verification link
Expected Result: A clear error message is shown with an option to resend

Test Case: Use the resend verification option on the verify-pending page
Expected Result: A new verification email is sent and confirmation is shown

Test Case: Attempt to sign in before verifying email
Expected Result: User is blocked or redirected to verify-pending as designed

Test Case: Sign in at /signin with valid verified credentials
Expected Result: User is signed in and redirected to the dashboard

Test Case: Sign in with an incorrect password
Expected Result: Error message is shown and user remains signed out

Test Case: Sign in with an unregistered email
Expected Result: Error message is shown without revealing whether the email exists

Test Case: Submit the signin form with empty fields
Expected Result: Validation errors are shown and no request is made

Test Case: Use Account menu > Sign Out
Expected Result: Session ends and user is returned to the public/signin page

Test Case: After signing out press the browser Back button
Expected Result: Protected pages are not accessible from cache; user is redirected to signin

Test Case: Navigate to /password and request a reset for a registered email
Expected Result: Confirmation is shown and a reset email is sent

Test Case: Request a reset for an unregistered email
Expected Result: Generic confirmation is shown (no account enumeration)

Test Case: Open the reset link and set a new valid password at /reset-password
Expected Result: Password is updated and user can sign in with the new password

Test Case: Open the reset link with an invalid or expired token
Expected Result: Token validation fails with a clear error and option to request a new link

Test Case: Attempt to sign in with the old password after a successful reset
Expected Result: Old password is rejected

Test Case: Update first/last name via the account settings
Expected Result: Names are saved and reflected in the UI after reload

Test Case: While signed out navigate directly to /dashboard
Expected Result: User is redirected to signin

Test Case: While signed out navigate directly to a /study/[id] URL
Expected Result: User is redirected to signin

Test Case: While signed in navigate to /signin or /signup
Expected Result: User is redirected to the app (not shown auth pages) as designed

Test Case: While signed out verify the auth toolbar shows Home / Sign In / Sign Up / Password buttons
Expected Result: Each button navigates to its correct page

Test Case: Sign in then close and reopen the browser
Expected Result: Session persists (or expires) according to the configured session policy
